claims.claim: Full name Vivek Hallegere Murthy, born July 10, 1977, in Huddersfield, England
Family moved to Newfoundland in 1978 and to Miami when he was three
His father ran a medical clinic in Miami
Valedictorian of Miami Palmetto Senior High School, 1994
Harvard BA in biochemical sciences, magna cum laude, 1997; Yale MD and MBA, 2003
Bachelor's from Harvard, MD and MBA from Yale, residency at Brigham and Women's Hospital, faculty at Harvard Medical School
Co-founded VISIONS (1995) and the Swasthya project (1997)
Founded Doctors for America in 2008 and co-founded TrialNetworks (clinical trial software)
Confirmed December 15, 2014, by a 51 to 43 vote, aged 37, first Indian American Surgeon General; NRA objected to his view of guns as a public health issue
Nomination delayed over a year; 2012 tweet on gun violence as a public health problem
Served as 19th Surgeon General from December 15, 2014 to April 21, 2017 and as 21st from March 23, 2021 to January 20, 2025
First-term reports: Facing Addiction in America, e-cigarette report, 2016 opioid letter to 2.3 million health professionals
Asked to resign by the Trump administration in April 2017; Rear Admiral Sylvia Trent-Adams became acting Surgeon General
Together published 2020
Co-chair of the COVID-19 advisory board from November 9, 2020; second confirmation March 23, 2021, 57 to 43
Advisory Our Epidemic of Loneliness and Isolation released May 2, 2023; health risk figures
About one in two American adults reported loneliness; national strategy with six pillars
Advisory on social media and youth mental health issued May 23, 2023
Advisory on firearm violence issued June 2024, calling it an urgent public health crisis
Advisory on alcohol and cancer risk issued January 3, 2025, calling for updated warning labels
Married Alice Chen in 2015; two children; Soros Fellowship, American University honorary degree (2023), TIME100 Health (2024)

uncertain: Start of first term: his own site and Tulane give December 15, 2014 (the confirmation date); Wikipedia's infobox as summarized gave April 22, 2015 (likely the formal commissioning ceremony). The profile states only the confirmation date.
End of first term: his site gives April 21, 2017; the ABC News summary read April 22, 2017. The profile says April 2017.
Firearm violence advisory date: the ACEP release is dated June 25, 2024, and was summarized as June 24. The profile says June 2024.

hhs.gov, surgeongeneral PDF pages, Britannica, CNN, AP and NPR could not be fetched (403, 451 or timeouts), so term dates rest on vivekmurthy.com, Tulane, WBUR and Wikipedia rather than hhs.gov directly.
The '15 cigarettes a day' comparison and the 2017 departure statement quote were seen only in search snippets or a single summarized fetch, so both were left out.
Parents' and sister's names appear on his own site but were left out under the living-person rule. No verified information on activities after January 20, 2025 was found.
